title: Prognostic Factors for Progression-Free Survival in Patients with Advanced Gastric Cancer Treated with First-Line Nivolumab Plus Oxaliplatin-Based Chemotherapy: Combined Clinical and Baseline CT Features.
snippet: Although nivolumab plus platinum-based chemotherapy has been approved as a first-line systemic treatment for advanced gastric cancer (AGC), the pretreatment imaging and clinical factors associated with disease progression remain incompletely understood. title: Circulating Metabolic Changes Accompanying Intestinal Injury After Total-Body Irradiation in Mice.
